scientific_integrity: Analytic proofs given for all claimed limits and entropy; numerical checks are explicitly finite. Classical Poisson and achievement-set ingredients are credited. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive sparse intensity; proposition-free, depth-one outdegree-counting only; no claim for nested modal formulas, labels, general GNNs, first-order graph sentences, or intensities varying with graph size. The finite checker is illustrative, not infinite or independent certification. Historical priority remains contingent on broader older achievement-set or sparse-modal studies.
title: Poisson Cantor spectrum and sharp precision entropy for one-step modal counting
